node.title: A=1 core-one quartic-carrier exclusion
node.closure: degree-four pole interpolation with carrier descent
node.statement: For every half-distance A=1 core-one profile, a bidegree-(4,floor(p/5)) pole-clearing form excludes the profile whenever floor(p/5)+ell+3<e. If that form contains the contact-active components, their product has domain degree at most four, and factoring the Forney numerator through every inactive component creates a forbidden degree-at-most-four kernel vector. Every survivor satisfies ell>=e-3-floor(Delta/5). On the official row this closes every core-one degree below floor(16m/13), moving the first surviving degree to 169155635042.
